This is my favorite arc in the series so far. Kaoru aka sexhair is the best girl from Amagami in my opinion.

I love her attitude and the issues she's struggling with throughout the arc, like how she has trouble with her mom moving on from her dad and dating again.

I felt that Junchi and Kaoru had the deepest connection with each other compared to the other girls. A lot of this arc is Junchi helping Kaoru out, and being her shoulder to cry on. Their bond goes back years and they both play off each other really well.

The last episode was also my favorite finale from the arcs I've seen so far, and it was one of the most implied "they did it" scenes. I really enjoyed how Kaoru and Juinchi played off each other and how deep their emotional bond was. Best arc out of the entire show.
